title: Naruto
synopsis:
Twelve years ago, a colossal demon fox terrorized the world. During the monster's attack on the Hidden Leaf Village, the Hokage—the village's leader and most powerful ninja—sacrifices himself to seal the beast inside a newborn, relieving civilization from destruction while dooming the baby to a lonely life.

Now, after years of being shunned and bullied, Naruto Uzumaki pesters the village with elaborate pranks and vandalism. Despite these antics, he works hard to achieve his dream: to become the Hokage and earn the acknowledgement of those who have mistreated him for his entire life. Naruto joins Team 7, a ninja squad made up of two of his peers—prodigy Sasuke Uchiha and clever Sakura Haruno.

Under the aloof Kakashi Hatake's leadership, Team 7 takes on a series of difficult missions, forcing its members to grow in strength and comradery despite their many differences. Naruto strives to stand out in his rivalry with Sasuke and earn the romantic affection of Sakura. But as the trio brush against danger and death, their tragic pasts threaten to tear them apart.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Enter: Naruto Uzumaki!
episodes_data.description: Welcome to the Village Hidden in the Leaves, where deadly serious ninja roam the land and the seriously mischievous Naruto Uzumaki causes trouble everywhere he goes.

episodes_data.title: My Name Is Konohamaru!
episodes_data.description: Naruto finally graduates from the Ninja Academy and claims to know it all.

episodes_data.title: Sasuke and Sakura: Friends or Foes?
episodes_data.description: On the way to becoming a ninja, Naruto must team up with his classmates, the pretty Sakura and the pretty serious Sasuke...

episodes_data.title: Pass or Fail: Survival Test
episodes_data.description: Now that Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura are a team, they meet with their sensei, the enigmatic and aloof Kakashi.

episodes_data.title: You Failed! Kakashi's Final Decision
episodes_data.description: With the threat of failure hanging over their heads, Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura try everything they know to pass the grueling survival test.

episodes_data.title: A Dangerous Mission! Journey to the Land of Waves!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his squad start their first ninja missions with boring and menial tasks. Weary and angry, Naruto vents his frustration at the Hokage.

episodes_data.title: The Assassin of the Mist!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his squad arrive in the Land of the Waves and learn that an evil businessman named Gato has taken over the land.

episodes_data.title: The Oath of Pain
episodes_data.description: Kakashi has the upper hand in his battle with Zabuza.

episodes_data.title: Kakashi: Sharingan Warrior!
episodes_data.description: Thanks to Naruto`s ingenious plan, Kakashi is freed from the water prison.

episodes_data.title: The Forest of Chakra
episodes_data.description: Recuperating at Tazuna`s house, Kakashi is dissatisfied with the outcome of the battle.

episodes_data.title: The Land Where a Hero Once Lived
episodes_data.description: Sakura goes into town with Tazuna and sees the hardships that the people of the Land of Waves suffer under Gato`s rule. Meanwhile, Naruto and Sasuke continue to train, using chakra to climb a tree.

episodes_data.title: Battle on the Bridge! Zabuza Returns!
episodes_data.description: While Naruto concentrates on the training to control his chakra, a mysterious person suddenly appears before him.

episodes_data.title: Haku's Secret Jutsu: Crystal Ice Mirrors
episodes_data.description: Once again, the time has come to fight Zabuza, and this time he`s got company--the tracking ninja who supposedly killed him.

episodes_data.title: The Number One Hyperactive, Knucklehead Ninja Joins the Fight!
episodes_data.description: Sasuke finds himself in a pinch inside of Haku`s Crystal Ice Mirrors, but Naruto comes to the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Zero Visibility: The Sharingan Shatters
episodes_data.description: Realizing time is of the essence, Kakashi decides to use the Sharingan once again to defeat Zabuza.

episodes_data.title: The Broken Seal
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Sasuke continue to receive punishing attacks from within Haku`s Crystal Ice Mirrors.

episodes_data.title: White Past: Hidden Ambition
episodes_data.description: Naruto finally explodes! His anger against Haku, who defeated Sasuke, unleashes the power of the Nine-tailed Fox.

episodes_data.title: The Weapons Known as Shinobi
episodes_data.description: Naruto strongly questions Haku`s philosophy of existing only to fight and win. Meanwhile, the battle between Kakashi and Zabuza approaches its climax.

episodes_data.title: The Demon in the Snow
episodes_data.description: Thinking of Haku, Naruto angrily confronts Zabuza. Zabuza is devastated by the loss of Haku, the only person he could trust in the world.

episodes_data.title: A New Chapter Begins: The Chunin Exam!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his team return to the Village Hidden in the Leaves after their battle in Land of Waves.

episodes_data.title: Identify Yourself: Powerful New Rivals
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura are among those chosen to take the Chunin (middle rank ninja) Qualification Exam.

episodes_data.title: Chunin Challenge: Rock Lee vs. Sasuke!
episodes_data.description: As Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura prepare for the exam, a ninja with short bobbed hair and thick eyebrows named Rock Lee appears. Lee proceeds to challenge Sasuke to a duel.

episodes_data.title: Genin Takedown! All Nine Rookies Face Off!
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura officially register for the Chunin Exam. In this examination, three ninja form a team, and in order to pass, not a single member is allowed to fail. Teamwork becomes absolutely vital for success in this test.

episodes_data.title: Start Your Engines: The Chunin Exam Begins
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his team begin the first exam, a written test. The exam proctor is a special jonin (upper rank ninja) named Ibiki Morino, who is an infamous expert in interrogation.

episodes_data.title: The Tenth Question: All or Nothing!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his team begin the first exam, a written test. The exam proctor is a special jonin (upper rank ninja) named Ibiki Morino, who is an infamous expert in interrogation.

episodes_data.title: Special Report: Live from the Forest of Death!
episodes_data.description: Konohamaru, the grandson of the Leaf Village`s Third Hokage, shows up at the Chunin Exam site.

episodes_data.title: The Chunin Exam Stage 2: The Forest of Death
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his fellow participants arrive at the Forest of Death, the site of the second part of the Chunin Exam.

episodes_data.title: Eat or Be Eaten: Panic in the Forest
episodes_data.description: The second exam starts in the Forest of Death. Sasuke notices that an enemy has disguised himself as Naruto.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Counterattack: Never Give In!
episodes_data.description: The Grass ninja that attacks Sasuke and Sakura has more power than the two can handle.

episodes_data.title: The Sharingan Revived: Dragon Flame Jutsu!
episodes_data.description: Seeing Naruto furiously fight back against the Grass ninja, Sasuke realizes that he was wrong to think about fleeing the scene of a battle.

episodes_data.title: Bushy Brow's Pledge: Undying Love and Protection
episodes_data.description: After receiving the report from her staff, Anko senses that Orochimaru has snuck into the examination.

episodes_data.title: Sakura Blossoms!
episodes_data.description: Protecting Sakura, who can no longer move, Lee battles the three Sound ninja himself.

episodes_data.title: Battle Formation: Ino-Shika-Cho!
episodes_data.description: While Sakura fends off the Sound ninja attack by herself, the rival Ino team appears!

episodes_data.title: Akamaru Trembles: Gaara's Cruel Strength!
episodes_data.description: The Sound ninja depart after witnessing Sasuke`s intense power. Naruto`s team finally gets a moment of peace to recuperate.

episodes_data.title: The Scroll's Secret: No Peeking Allowed
episodes_data.description: To heal their wounds, Naruto and his team take a much-needed rest after their battle against the Sound ninja. But it has already been four days since the start of the exam and there is only one day remaining until time expires.

episodes_data.title: Clone vs. Clone: Mine Are Better Than Yours!
episodes_data.description: Naruto`s team joins Kabuto on their journey to the tower, but on the way, they are trapped by the genjutsu (illusion technique) of the Hidden Rain Village`s genin (low rank ninja), Oboro`s team.

episodes_data.title: Surviving the Cut! The Rookie Nine Together Again!
episodes_data.description: When Naruto and his team open the two scrolls after reaching the tower, Iruka suddenly appears.

episodes_data.title: Narrowing the Field: Sudden Death Elimination!
episodes_data.description: The 21 ninjas that passed the second exam assemble for their next challenge.

episodes_data.title: Bushy Brow's Jealousy: Lions Barrage Unleashed!
episodes_data.description: The preliminaries for the third exam are one on one combat, and the first match is between Sasuke and Orochimaru`s minion Yoroi.

episodes_data.title: Kakashi and Orochimaru: Face-to-Face!
episodes_data.description: As Kakashi safely releases Sasuke from the spell, Orochimaru suddenly shows up. Orochimaru expresses his desire for the power of Sharingan that the Uchiha clan holds in order to fulfill his ambitions.

episodes_data.title: Kunoichi Rumble: The Rivals Get Serious!
episodes_data.description: The preliminaries continue as the next match pits Sand ninja Gaara`s teammate Kankuro against Orochimaru`s minion Misumi.

episodes_data.title: The Ultimate Battle: Cha!
episodes_data.description: The fourth match is between Sakura and Ino, who are childhood friends and competitors for the affection of Sasuke.

episodes_data.title: Killer Kunoichi and a Shaky Shikamaru
episodes_data.description: The fifth match is between Tenten and Temari. The sixth match is Shikamaru versus Kin.

episodes_data.title: Akamaru Unleashed! Who's Top Dog Now?
episodes_data.description: In the seventh match, Naruto clashes against Kiba, who brings along his dog Akamaru.

episodes_data.title: Surprise Attack! Naruto's Secret Weapon!
episodes_data.description: By consuming Food Pills, Kiba and Akamaru increase their chakra levels and start their counterattack on Naruto.

episodes_data.title: Byakugan Battle: Hinata Grows Bold!
episodes_data.description: Cousins Hinata and Neji of the Hyuga clan confront each other in the eighth match.

episodes_data.title: A Failure Stands Tall!
episodes_data.description: Hinata goes up against Neji, but he hits her pressure point by using his Byakugan (white eyes). Hinata`s flow of chakra is stopped, and she almost loses consciousness.

episodes_data.title: Gaara vs. Rock Lee: The Power of Youth Explodes!
episodes_data.description: Gaara finally appears in the ninth match, and his opponent is taijutsu (physical technique) specialist Lee.

episodes_data.title: Lee's Hidden Strength: Forbidden Secret Jutsu!
episodes_data.description: Lee uses the banned technique Primary Lotus to attack Gaara.

episodes_data.title: The Fifth Gate: A Splendid Ninja Is Born
episodes_data.description: Lee decides to use the forbidden move, Hidden Lotus, as a last resort.

episodes_data.title: A Shadow in Darkness: Danger Approaches Sasuke
episodes_data.description: In the final match of the preliminaries, Choji fights against Orochimaru`s minion Dosu. The preliminaries are finally over, and the Hokage reveals the third exam.

episodes_data.title: Ebisu Returns: Naruto's Toughest Training Yet!
episodes_data.description: In preparation for the third exam that starts in a month, Naruto`s former mentor, Kakashi, chooses Ebisu to train the young ninja.

episodes_data.title: Long Time No See: Jiraiya Returns!
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya, one of the legendary Three Ninja, suddenly appears before Ebisu and Naruto. Naruto gives Jiraiya the nickname, "Pervy Sage."

episodes_data.title: The Summoning Jutsu: Wisdom of the Toad Sage!
episodes_data.description: The Sound Ninja Dosu appears before Gaara and intends on defeating Gaara. But Gaara beats him soundly. Stealthily watching them are a Jonin of the Sand Village and Kabuto!

episodes_data.title: A Feeling of Yearning, A Flower Full of Hope
episodes_data.description: Naruto continues training under Jiraiya to master the "Summoning Jutsu" which enables him to call forth various living beasts. But he has a hard time controlling the Chakra of the Nine-Tailed Fox...

episodes_data.title: Live or Die: Risk It All to Win It All!
episodes_data.description: It is three weeks since Naruto began training under Jiraiya. And Naruto has been on the brink of collapse many times.

episodes_data.title: He Flies! He Jumps! He Lurks! Chief Toad Appears!
episodes_data.description: Naruto is finally able to draw out the Nine-Tail Chakra and utilize the "Summoning Jutsu." Gamabunta appears and does not believe that Naruto summoned him.

episodes_data.title: Hospital Besieged: The Evil Hand Revealed!
episodes_data.description: On the day of the test, Gaara disappears from the inn where the Sand Ninja are staying and goes to Hidden Leaf Hospital.

episodes_data.title: The Final Rounds: Rush to the Battle Arena!
episodes_data.description: The day of the Exam finally arrives. Naruto’s first opponent is Neji Hyuga.

episodes_data.title: Byakugan vs. Shadow Clone Jutsu!
episodes_data.description: Finally, Chunin Exam starts with the eight Ninja who qualified in the preliminaries. But Sasuke is nowhere to be found.

episodes_data.title: Ultimate Defense: Zero Blind Spot!
episodes_data.description: Naruto is unable to use his Shadow Clone Jutsu against Neji who can see chakra points!

episodes_data.title: A Failure's True Power
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Neji’s battle continue with Neji showing enormous power.

episodes_data.title: Hit It or Quit It: The Final Rounds Get Complicated!
episodes_data.description: Defeated by Naruto, Neji is being taken to the hospital, when Neji’s uncle Hiashi appears.

episodes_data.title: Zero Motivation: The Guy with Cloud Envy!
episodes_data.description: Sasuke’s match is postponed and suddenly, it is Shikamaru’s turn. He has shown no eagerness to fight, thinking that his is merely a secondary match…

episodes_data.title: Dancing Leaf, Squirming Sand
episodes_data.description: In the Shikamaru and Temari’s match, Shikamaru who had the upper hand suddenly makes a surprising decision!

episodes_data.title: Bushy Brow's Jutsu: Sasuke Style!
episodes_data.description: Sasuke and Gaara’a anticipated match begins. Gaara eerily talks to himself, as though addressing someone.

episodes_data.title: Late for the Show, but Ready to Go! The Ultimate Secret Technique Is Born!
episodes_data.description: Sauske`s speed and moves are identical to Lee’s Taijutsu. But Gaara is not an opponent who can be defeated with just Taijutsu.

episodes_data.title: Zero Hour! The Destruction of the Hidden Leaf Village Begins!
episodes_data.description: During the match, someone has used Genjutsu to put everyone in the arena to sleep. The Sand Ninja led by Orochimaru have begun their plan to destroy the Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: Village in Distress: A New A-Ranked Mission!
episodes_data.description: The Sound and Sand Ninja, along with Orochimaru, begin their move to destroy Hidden Leaf Village. The arena has become a battleground.

episodes_data.title: A Shirker's Call to Action: Layabout No More!
episodes_data.description: Along with Pakkun, Naruto, Sakura and Shikamaru are in hot pursuit of Sasuke. Pakkun senses nine of Orochimaru`s men coming after them.

episodes_data.title: An Unrivaled Match: Hokage Battle Royale!
episodes_data.description: Orochimaru traps the Hokage inside a barrier and continue to battle.

episodes_data.title: A Mistake from the Past: A Face Revealed!
episodes_data.description: Sasuke finally catches up to Gaara, Temari, and Kankuro. Kankuro escapes with Gaara leaving Temari to face Sasuke.

episodes_data.title: Forbidden Secret Technique! Reaper Death Seal!
episodes_data.description: The battle between the Hokage and Orochimaru rages on. Finally, the Hokage resorts to a Jutsu unknown to Orochimaru, the Sealing Jutsu known as “Reaper Death Seal.”

episodes_data.title: Astonishing Truth: Gaara's Identity Emerges!
episodes_data.description: Shino appears as Sasuke and Kankuro battle. Leaving Shino to handle Kankuro, Sasuke goes after Gaara.

episodes_data.title: Sasuke's Decision: Pushed to the Edge
episodes_data.description: Half of Gaara’s body has transformed and Sasuke continues his battle against him.

episodes_data.title: An Assassin of the Moonlit Night
episodes_data.description: By the time Naruto and Sakura catch up, Sasuke has exhausted his strength and collapsed.

episodes_data.title: Light vs. Dark: The Two Faces of Gaara
episodes_data.description: Naruto is helpless against Gara’s immense power. While Naruto declares that he fights for his comrades, Gaara says he fights for himself.

episodes_data.title: Naruto's Ninja Handbook
episodes_data.description: Naruto is helpless against Gaara’s overpowering strength. However, after seeing Sasuke risking life and limb to save him and Sakura…

episodes_data.title: Beyond the Limit of Darkness and Light
episodes_data.description: Naruto is helpless against Gaara’s overpowering strength. However, after seeing Sasuke risking life and limb to save him and Sakura…

episodes_data.title: The Third Hokage, Forever...
episodes_data.description: With every ounce of their power, Gaara and Naruto continue to fight. Determined to protect Sakura, Naruto attacks Gaara again and again.

episodes_data.title: Return of the Morning Mist
episodes_data.description: Orochimaru`s plan to destroy the Village Hidden in the Leaves is stopped. But the damage is extensive and work proceeds quickly to make repairs.

episodes_data.title: Eye to Eye: Sharingan vs. Sharingan!
episodes_data.description: Kakashi arrives in the nick of time to help Asuma and Kurenai, and Itachi too enters the fray. The ultimate battle between two Sharingan users begins.

episodes_data.title: Jiraiya: Naruto's Potential Disaster!
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya and Naruto are on a journey to find Tsunade, one of the legendary Sannin. Jiraiya`s purpose is both to protect Naruto from the clutches of the mysterious organization the Akatsuki and to train his apprentice.

episodes_data.title: Roar, Chidori! Brother vs. Brother!
episodes_data.description: Intent on confronting Itachi, Sasuke rushes to the town where Naruto is staying. On the way, tragic memories of his past come flooding back.

episodes_data.title: Hate Among the Uchihas: The Last of the Clan!
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya saves Naruto from Kisame just in time. It turns out that Itachi and the Akatsuki organization are definitely after Naruto to obtain the power of the Nine-Tailed Fox.

episodes_data.title: A New Training Begins: I Will Be Strong!
episodes_data.description: Deeply hurt mentally and physically, Sasuke is taken back to the Hidden Leaf Village by Guy. If only the medical specialist Tsunade were there...

episodes_data.title: Keep on Training: Pop Goes the Water Balloon!
episodes_data.description: Naruto finally begins his training with Jiraiya. The technique Naruto will learn was the trademark of the Fourth Hokage, a technique which even a genius like him took three years to master.

episodes_data.title: Focal Point: The Mark of the Leaf
episodes_data.description: Naruto manages to complete the first step of his training. But the next step, making a rubber ball explode with chakra, proves extremely difficult.

episodes_data.title: An Impossible Choice: The Pain Within Tsunade's Heart
episodes_data.description: Orochimaru and Kabuto suddenly appear before Tsunade and Shizune who are out sightseeing. Orochimaru, injured by the Third Hokage`s Reaper Death Seal, seeks the former Sannin`s medical expertise.

episodes_data.title: Unforgivable! A Total Lack of Respect!
episodes_data.description: In exchange for healing his arms, Orochimaru offers to bring back to life Tsunade`s younger brother Nawaki and Dan, her sweetheart.

episodes_data.title: Inheritance! The Necklace of Death
episodes_data.description: Naruto is incensed at the way Tsunade disrespects the position of Hokage and challenges her to a fight.

episodes_data.title: A Dubious Offer! Tsunade's Choice
episodes_data.description: Naruto practices hard so he can win the necklace from Tsunade. Meanwhile, Tsunade is in a dilemma over Orochimaru`s offer.

episodes_data.title: Breakdown! The Deal Is Off!
episodes_data.description: Gripped by the desire to see Nawaki and Dan, Tsunade almost succumbs to Orochimaru`s tempting offer.

episodes_data.title: Attack! Fury of the Rasengan!
episodes_data.description: Orochimaru and Kabuto use a summoning jutsu to call forth a giant snake. Still drugged and unable to fully use his chakra, Jiraiya summons little Gamakichi.

episodes_data.title: The Fifth Hokage! A Life on the Line!
episodes_data.description: Naruto`s ninja way is to never go back on his word. Naruto is seriously injured by Kabuto and hovers on the verge of death.

episodes_data.title: Deadlock! Sannin Showdown!
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya, Tsunade and Orochimaru all release their summoning jutsu. And a fierce battle begins.

episodes_data.title: Kidnapped! Naruto's Hot Springs Adventure!
episodes_data.description: Tsunade, Naruto, and the others start heading back to the Leaf Village where Tsunade will formally become the Fifth Hokage. At Tsunade`s urging, they stop at a town with hot springs.

episodes_data.title: Tsunade's Warning: Ninja No More!
episodes_data.description: Naruto asks Tsunade to heal Sasuke and Lee before she is installed as the Hokage. After examining Lee, she tells him to find a path other than of that of a shinobi.

episodes_data.title: The Will of Fire Still Burns!
episodes_data.description: Lee hesitates when Tsunade asks him whether he will quit pursuing the path of a ninja or choose to undergo a risky surgery with only a fifty percent chance of success.

episodes_data.title: The Sensei and the Student: Bond of the Shinobi
episodes_data.description: After being advised by Tsunade to quit the path of the shinobi, Lee recalls his first meeting with his teacher Guy. Unable to master either ninjutsu or genjutsu, Lee has always been looked down upon by the others.

episodes_data.title: Gotta See! Gotta Know! Kakashi Sensei's True Face!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his two squadmates have always wanted to see what Kakashi looks like under his mask. The three do whatever they can to reveal his whole face.

episodes_data.title: Mission: Help an Old Friend in the Land of Tea
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura are sent on a B-rank mission to the neighboring Land of Tea. They are to protect the runners in a race being held during the Todoroki Shrine`s ceremonial ritual held every four years.

episodes_data.title: The Race Is On! Trouble on the High Seas!
episodes_data.description: The chief retainers think that Idate has made a farce of their great traditional festival. Jirocho believes that Idate has fled with some plan in mind.

episodes_data.title: Run Idate Run! Nagi Island Awaits!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and his squad manage to catch up to Idate, only to find him hurt and unconscious with Aoi nearby.

episodes_data.title: A Fierce Battle of Rolling Thunder!
episodes_data.description: Despite interference from Aoi, Idate continues his run. Idate still trusts no one, and it`s revealed that during the Chunin Exams, Idate`s older brother was the proctor who posed the tenth question.

episodes_data.title: The Last Leg: A Final Act of Desperation
episodes_data.description: Boss Jirocho waits, confident that Idate will win. But Aoi, the ninja sent by the Wagarashi clan, stands in the way.

episodes_data.title: The Battle Begins: Naruto vs. Sasuke
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru is promoted to chunin, and he and his squadmates celebrate at a BBQ restaurant. In the hospital, Lee decides to undergo a dangerous surgery to repair his body so that he can remain a ninja.

episodes_data.title: Bitter Rivals and Broken Bonds
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Sasuke release their ultimate weapons against each other, and just in time Kakashi arrives to stop the fight.

episodes_data.title: An Invitation from the Sound
episodes_data.description: The Sound Ninja Four, Kidomaru, Sakon, Jirobo and Tayuya, suddenly appear before Sasuke. Sakura is concerned about the Curse Mark placed on Sasuke by Orochimaru...

episodes_data.title: Formation! The Sasuke Retrieval Squad!
episodes_data.description: Sakura`s pleas fall on deaf ears, and Sasuke leaves Hidden Leaf Village. When Tsunade learns of this, she summons Shikamaru to lead his first mission as a chunin.

episodes_data.title: Sound vs. Leaf
episodes_data.description: The Sound Ninja Four race toward Orochimaru`s lair with Sasuke in hand. They`re discovered and challenged by the jonin Genma and Raido...

episodes_data.title: Squad Mutiny: Everything Falls Apart!
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others are trapped in Jirobo`s Earth Dome Prison. They try to pound their way out, but the walls regenerate each time.

episodes_data.title: Full Throttle Power! Choji, Ablaze!
episodes_data.description: After they are freed from the Earth Dome Prison, Shikamaru and the others take off after the remaining Sound while Choji stays behind.

episodes_data.title: Good-Bye Old Friend! I'll Always Believe in You!
episodes_data.description: After Choji takes the yellow pill it looks as if he may win the battle, until Jirobo transforms into Second State, giving him immense power.

episodes_data.title: Your Opponent Is Me!
episodes_data.description: Assuming that the Leaf Squad could never get past Jirobo, the remaining Sound ninja don`t bother to lay traps along the way.

episodes_data.title: 360 Degrees of Vision: The Byakugan's Blind Spot!
episodes_data.description: Neji takes on Kidomaru while the others continue their pursuit of Sasuke and the remaining Sound ninja.

episodes_data.title: Losing Is Not an Option
episodes_data.description: Kidomaru changes tactics and creates a bow and arrow to attack Neji`s blind spot.

episodes_data.title: The Vessel Arrives Too Late
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Shikamaru, Kiba and Akamaru are in hot pursuit of Sasuke and the Sound ninja. Naruto and Kiba are upset that they have been unable to catch up and decide to try a surprise attack at night.

episodes_data.title: Miscalculation: A New Enemy Appears!
episodes_data.description: Akamaru sets explosives in the trees to trap Sakon. But an incensed Sakon turns the tables, and the explosives end up sending Kiba, Akamaru and Sakon off a cliff.

episodes_data.title: Roar! Howl! The Ultimate Tag
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru is determined to stop Tayuya, but she uses her Summoning Jutsu to call forth three giants. Meanwhile, on the plains, the battle between Kimimaro and Naruto is about to begin.

episodes_data.title: Our Separate Battles
episodes_data.description: Ukon, who is able to infiltrate the bodies of others, enters Kiba`s body and tries to merge with his cells.

episodes_data.title: Fake! Shikamaru the Man, Who Bets on the Revival of the Dead.
episodes_data.description: An injured Kiba and Akamaru barely escape from Sakon and Ukon. Naruto is locked in battle with Kimimaro...

episodes_data.title: Konoha's Green Beast Appears
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru succeeds in trapping Tayuya with his Shadow Possession Jutsu. But Tayuya moves to her Second State and fights back with enormous strength.

episodes_data.title: The Beast Explodes! Burst, Blow, and Break Through
episodes_data.description: With Rock Lee there to take on Kimimaro, Naruto is free to chase after Sasuke, who has awakened.

episodes_data.title: Allies of Konoha! The Shinobi of the Sand!
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru, Kiba and Lee are at the limits of their strength when Gaara, Temari and Kankuro appear to assist their Leaf allies.

episodes_data.title: Showdown of the Strongest! Gaara vs. Kimimaro!!
episodes_data.description: Kimimaro realizes that close combat is impossible against Gaara`s wall of sand, so he moves further away for a long-distance attack.

episodes_data.title: Determination for One Blow! Dance of The Seeding Ferns
episodes_data.description: Kimimaro succeeds in shattering Gaara`s protective sand shield and attacks Gaara. Naruto finally catches up to Sasuke...

episodes_data.title: Unreachable Outcry
episodes_data.description: With the Curse Mark covering half his body, Sasuke is no longer the Sasuke of old. Naruto charges at this new Sasuke who has turned his back on his closest comrades.

episodes_data.title: Itachi and Sasuke. An Existence Too Far Apart.
episodes_data.description: Naruto tries desperately to change Sasuke`s mind, but Sasuke is determined to go to Orochimaru. He tells Naruto that in order to surpass his brother, Itachi, power and hatred are necessary.

episodes_data.title: Father and Son. The Cracked Family Crest
episodes_data.description: Naruto is brought down by Sasuke`s Fire Style: Fireball Jutsu. It is a jutsu passed down through generations of the Uchiha family...

episodes_data.title: Enlightenment. The Secret of Mangekyou Sharingan.
episodes_data.description: Sasuke quietly watches as Naruto sinks deeper in the water. He recalls the past, when the Uchiha clan was cruelly slaughtered.

episodes_data.title: Close Friend!
episodes_data.description: Kakashi uses his Summoning Jutsu and sends ninja dogs to track Naruto and Sasuke. With his newfound strength, Sasuke is serious about bringing down Naruto...

episodes_data.title: Tearful Yell! You Are My Friend.
episodes_data.description: Naruto releases his Nine-Tail chakra and sends Sasuke flying. Sasuke counters with his Fire Style Jutsu, but Naruto extinguishes the flames easily.

episodes_data.title: Concluded in a Rain of Tears
episodes_data.description: Naruto`s Nine-Tail chakra seems to move with a will of its own as it counters Sasuke`s powerful attacks.

episodes_data.title: The Promise That Couldn't Be Kept
episodes_data.description: The fierce battle with Sasuke leaves Naruto unconscious. Kakashi finally arrives at his side.

episodes_data.title: Infiltration investigation?! A Super S-Class Mission Has Finally Arrived!
episodes_data.description: Sakura tries to sneak out of the village to find Sasuke, but Naruto intercepts her.

episodes_data.title: The Town of Outlaws. The Shadow of the Fuuma Clan.
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Sakura and Jiraiya search for information in a town in the Land of Rice Paddies.

episodes_data.title: A Pure Betrayal. A Fleeting Wish.
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Sakura and Sasame are attacked by Kamikiri, Jigumo and Kagero of the Fuma Clan.

episodes_data.title: Terror! Orochimaru's Mansion
episodes_data.description: Jiraiya uses his Summoning Jutsu to call out Gamakichi. With Gamakichi leading the way, the shinobi advance up winding stairways and through long tunnels.

episodes_data.title: Two Heartbeats, Kabuto's Trap
episodes_data.description: Sakura is cornered by Orochimaru! Just as Kabuto is about to hurl his kunai at her, Naruto comes running in.

episodes_data.title: Sakura's Decision
episodes_data.description: Naruto tries to shield Sakura from an attack and is wounded by Kamikiri. Naruto laughs off his injury and counters with his Shadow Clone Jutsu...

episodes_data.title: Three Villians of the Strictly Guarded Facility
episodes_data.description: Naruto gets upset when Jiraiya sets out on a sudden mission without him. Jiraiya tells him to undergo special training during his absence and hands him a scroll.

episodes_data.title: Run Tonton! We're Counting On Your Nose
episodes_data.description: Shizune pursues Mizuki who has escaped from the Maximum Security Prison, but is overcome by him and the brothers Raijin and Fujin.

episodes_data.title: Rebirth of the Three Man Team: Two People and One Animal
episodes_data.description: Raijin and Fujin possess superhuman strength, and Naruto is no match for them.

episodes_data.title: Explosion! New Formation InoShikaChou
episodes_data.description: Shikamaru, Ino and Choji come to the rescue.

episodes_data.title: Leftover Ambitions Orochimaru's Shadow
episodes_data.description: Naruto discovers that Tsubaki is Mizuki`s fiancee. She has an idea of his whereabouts and asks the squad to take her with them.

episodes_data.title: Confrontation of Fate! You Will Not Defeat Me
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Iruka are left in a daze by the power of Mizuki`s chakra. Naruto counters with a jutsu but is quickly rebuffed.

episodes_data.title: Even Akamaru Is Jealous of His Searching Ability! Search for the Phantom Bikouchuu!
episodes_data.description: Kiba, Shino and Hinata have come up with an idea to use the Bikochu beetle to find Sasuke.

episodes_data.title: How Is It Different? Don't All Bugs Look the Same!?
episodes_data.description: Squad 8 and Naruto arrive at the Bikochu`s habitat. They use a photograph to guide them in their search...

episodes_data.title: Deceive, Confuse and Be Deceived! The Grand Bug Battle
episodes_data.description: Hinata is kidnapped by Suzumebachi and others from the Kamizuru Clan.

episodes_data.title: Blazing Byakugan! This Is My Way of the Ninja
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Kiba and Shino are pursued and find themselves cornered in the hive of a queen bee.

episodes_data.title: The Funeral March Towards Those with life
episodes_data.description: While training in the Hidden Leaf Village, Naruto rescues three men from the rapids who have come to request a mission.

episodes_data.title: Reach Your Heart! Fist of Love
episodes_data.description: The Kurosuki gang captures Rokusuke, and Raiga tells him that he will hold a funeral for him!

episodes_data.title: Byakugan's Natural Enemy
episodes_data.description: Raiga and Ranmaru use their Hidden Mist jutsu to conceal themselves in Katabami Gold Mine, where even Neji`s Byakugan cannot detect them.

episodes_data.title: The Creeping Dark Clouds
episodes_data.description: The Kurosuki Family is dispersed, and peace returns to Katabami Gold Mine.

episodes_data.title: Raiga's Counterattack!
episodes_data.description: Raiga comes back to life, only to see Ranmaru lying deathly still on the ground.

episodes_data.title: Run!!! The Curry of Life
episodes_data.description: Despite his injuries, Lee keeps on fighting desperately. But the tornado that envelopes Raiga`s attack takes the form of a dragon, and Lee is swallowed up by it.

episodes_data.title: Everyone Come with Me! The Survival Scheme of Sweat and Tears
episodes_data.description: Naruto is chosen to lead Konohamaru, Moegi and Udon in a survival training exercise. Their destination is the Stone Face of Warudakumi at the top of Mt. Takurami...

episodes_data.title: Enemy or Ally!? The Bratty Bounty Hunter
episodes_data.description: Tsunade orders Naruto, Hinata, Kiba and Akamaru on a mission to capture the thief Gosunkugi.

episodes_data.title: Will We Take It or Will It Be Taken from Us!? The Okay Temple's Battle
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others tend to an injured Sazanami. As Sazanami tells it, he had once been a swordsmith in a peaceful town and was framed for a murder committed by Gosunkugi.

episodes_data.title: A Welcome Visitor Arrives: The Green Beast? The Carnivore? ...The Welcomed Beast?
episodes_data.description: While Guy and Lee are away, two impostors dressed like them sneak into Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: A Cursed White Warrior
episodes_data.description: The Land of Birds is in turmoil due to a specter known as the Cursed Warrior, which is believed to be the ghost of Lord Owashi, the previous feudal lord who died suddenly.

episodes_data.title: Tactician: Koumei's Speculation
episodes_data.description: Moso, the late feudal lord`s counselor, and Komei, the chief strategist, are at odds with each other. Neji begins to think that the Cursed Warrior is part of a plot

episodes_data.title: The Helper Who Came Too Late
episodes_data.description: Komei is controlling the Cursed Warrior. Moso thwarts Komei`s ambitions. The Leaf team feels uneasy about his motives. Neji doesn`t want to get involved, but Naruto is defiant. Gamakichi and Gamatatsu is summoned to investigate...

episodes_data.title: Naruto Dies
episodes_data.description: Tenten and Neji have no choice but to listen to Kakashi. He senses that their being followed. Komei has been declared a criminal and is to be executed. The Cursed Warrior appears and snatches Komei away.

episodes_data.title: Time Is Stopped
episodes_data.description: Sagi swears to punish Moso himself. Naruto is reminded of Sasuke when he sees Sagi. Neither words nor Naruto`s attempts to stop him can deter Sagi from his chosen path of revenge.

episodes_data.title: White Heron's Flapping Wings of Time
episodes_data.description: At Moso`s mansion, a battle takes place between the Wandering Ninja and a Leaf Ninja. With Chishima`s help, Naruto is freed from Moso`s genjutsu. Moso then reveals his true form as the leader of the Wandering ninja, Hoki!

episodes_data.title: Burn Zundou! Mix, Stretch and Boil It Up!
episodes_data.description: Choji and Naruto is craving Ichiraku`s special ramen only to find out that they find the shop closed! Teuchi reveals that his daughter has been kidnapped by Ryonin, aka the Ninja Chefs, who is after his secret recipes!

episodes_data.title: Remembrance: The Lost Page
episodes_data.description: The Demon of the Ocean is wreaking havoc in the Land of the Sea. Anko leads a team consisting with Naruto, Ino, and Shino. It turns out Anko has an unexpected history with the Land of the Sea.

episodes_data.title: Impact: The Closed Door
episodes_data.description: Unable to find Naruto, Anko meets with officials from the Land of the Sea. The ship carrying government funds that they were supposed to guard sets sail the next day!

episodes_data.title: Sneaking: The Planned Trap
episodes_data.description: Unable to find Naruto, Anko meets with officials from the Land of the Sea. The ship carrying government funds that they were supposed to guard sets sail the next day!

episodes_data.title: Despair: The Broken Heart
episodes_data.description: Amachi and his gang begin their attack on the government ship. Naruto and the others escape from Demon Island, but the sight that greets them is the Land of the Sea fleet on the verge of annihilation.

episodes_data.title: Sea Battle: The Released Power
episodes_data.description: The Hidden Leaf ninja and Amachi battle it out at sea. With Naruto`s help, Amachi is defeated, but then a monster appears. Naruto summons Gamabunta in order to defeat the monster.

episodes_data.title: No Way! Celebrity Ninpou: Jutsu of Gold Element
episodes_data.description: Kunijiro visists Tsunade and decides to have Naruto guide his boy through one day in the life of a ninja!

episodes_data.title: Dig Here! Woof! Woof! The Search for Buried Treasure
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Kiba, and Hinata are searching for buried treasue at the request of Tsunade`s friend Agari Kaisen. Thinking it`s an easy task since they have a map, Tsunade threatens to send them back to the Academy if they fail.

episodes_data.title: Zigzag Running! Chasing, Being Chased, Making a Mistake
episodes_data.description: After escaping from the cave, Naruto and the others chase after the Kedouin in order to put a halt to their plot, but the Village Hidden in the Leaves is already under attack.

episodes_data.title: Oh?! Please, Mister Postman.
episodes_data.description: Naruto discovers Jiraiya is up to no good. Jiraiya claims to be busy getting his manuscript ready before his deadline. Impatient and irritated, Naruto writes his own manuscript for Jiraiya!

episodes_data.title: Encounter: The Boy Named 'Hoshi'.
episodes_data.description: Hidden Leaf Village receives a request from the Village Hidden in the Stars to guard a star. The star is actually a meteorite that fell 200 years ago and is said to possess mysterious powers.

episodes_data.title: Natsuhiboshi: Remembered Lullaby
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others investigates the whereabouts of the stolen star. The team suspects that is an inside job because the ninja who took the star used the ninja art, Kujaku, from the Star Village.

episodes_data.title: Secret Technique: Compensation of Peacock Mysteries.
episodes_data.description: Akahoshi, the masked ninja who kidnapped Sumaru, intends to use Sumaru to call out the mysterious ninja who stole the star.

episodes_data.title: Hoshikage: The Buried Truth.
episodes_data.description: The masked ninja and Naruto fall into the depths of the Valley. While tending to Naruto`s wounds, the masked ninja tells him the reason for stealing the star.

episodes_data.title: Meeting Again: The Time Left Behind
episodes_data.description: Natsuhi`s body is reacting to the effects of the star. She wields the star and desperately confronts Akahoshi, but Sumaru is taken hostage

episodes_data.title: Enhance the Star's Brilliance
episodes_data.description: Sumaru senses his mother`s death and Naruto is unable to stop an angry Sumaru from running off. To save Sumaru, Hokuto and Mizura stake their lives to reveal the truth behind the star training.

episodes_data.title: Inuzuka Kiba's Long Day
episodes_data.description: Akamaru is injured by a rival shinobi from another nation. The shinobi used a battle skill that spreads bacteria throughout the opponent`s body, infecting the vicitim`s mental faculties. This causes Akamaru to go into uncontrollable rampage!

episodes_data.title: A Legend Has Existed in Konoha
episodes_data.description: A mysterious being attaches itself to Naruto, while he was training in the forest. Tsunade begins to wonder if it isn`t the legendary being known as the "Onbaa."

episodes_data.title: Laugh Shino
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Shino are given a mission to provide security during the Kagetsu family funeral, but they soon realize that the real mission is to help the eldest son carry out the man`s unusual last will and testament!

episodes_data.title: Open for Business!! Konoha House Moving Center
episodes_data.description: A ominous black smoke appears over the Land of Greens, and all of sudden Choji and company are attacked by an unidentified Ninja!

episodes_data.title: Mystery: The Targeted Peddler
episodes_data.description: While questioning Yurinoshin and Shun, the Hidden Leaf squad learns the truth about Shun`s true identity. She is Princess Haruna, the only daughter of the Feudal Lord of the Land of Greens!

episodes_data.title: Underwater! An Inexhaustible Amount of Ninja Weapons
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others is attacked by Ruiga, the first evil ninja, who can draw water from the earth to use as weapons. Naruto soon discovers a way to reverse the odds of their battle!

episodes_data.title: Byakugan Saw It! The Magnet User's Blind Spot
episodes_data.description: Naruto is again attacked by the second evil ninja, Jiga. Jiga threatens Naruto`s life when Hinata rushes in to save Naruto, but Hinata resists the threats and begins to fight!

episodes_data.title: Death Sentence, "Cloudy, with Some Clear Sky"
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Haruna is confronted by Renga. Declaring that he has taken down others before them, he advances on Naruto, ordering him to hand over the princess!

episodes_data.title: Ino Screams! Chubby Paradise
episodes_data.description: The princess has gained weight due to nerves and wants Ino to pose as the princess in order to attend the first meeting with a prince she adores.

episodes_data.title: Viva Training Group Challenge
episodes_data.description: Lee opens a dojo because he feels like he isn`t keeping up with his training. He is hoping challengers will come to his dojo to face him in battle.

episodes_data.title: Grotesque: The Cursed Ghost Castle
episodes_data.description: The first lady of the Land of Honey and her entourage have disappeared. Naruto, Kiba, and Hinata are sent on a mission and they discover an eerie castle looming in the middle of the road!

episodes_data.title: The Third Great Beast: The Greatest Rival
episodes_data.description: During Lee`s medical check-up, he discovers that there`s a lot of damage in his chakra network. Guy tries to cheer him up by taking Lee to the Academy training hall.

episodes_data.title: Clash of Tears! Hot Blooded Teacher and Student Showdown
episodes_data.description: Seeking revenge for his dead father, Genho, Yagura`s true identity and oldest sibling of the Ryudoin Brothers, confronts Guy using a unique Jutsu.

episodes_data.title: The Konoha 11 Gather!
episodes_data.description: The ANBU Black Ops suspect that Genno, a carpenter of Hidden Leaf Village, stole important blueprints of the village. Tsunade concludes that the one who used Genno plans to attack the Village and puts the village on Super S-Rank Alert!

episodes_data.title: The Anbu Also Gave Up: Naruto's Recollection
episodes_data.description: ANBU Black Ops puts Naruto under retro-hypnosis to extract Genno`s motives. Without much success, Hidden Waterfall Village will be conducting maneuvers close to the village borders.

episodes_data.title: Missing the Mark: The Visible Target
episodes_data.description: While looking for the scattered blueprints, Naruto and his team realize that Genno`s actions are a diversion.

episodes_data.title: Working Hard on Active Duty: The Strongest Helper
episodes_data.description: Naruto and the others are shocked at the number of paper bombs placed throughout the village. While removing the seals, unexpected help arrives in the way of Homura and Koharu.

episodes_data.title: Multiple Traps: Countdown to Collapse
episodes_data.description: Naruto confronts Genno, and Shikamaru realizes that all the traps are all diversions. Genno`s intention was to bury the village in a rockslide. Can the 11 ninja save the village from destruction?

episodes_data.title: Today's Announcement! Top 5 Battles with Sweat and Tear
episodes_data.description: Naruto, Uzumaki, and Sakura take the microphones as hosts and then the program begins.

episodes_data.title: Kurenai's Decision: Team 8 Left Behind
episodes_data.description: Naruto encounters a young girl named Yakumo drawing a strange picture. The ANBU Black Ops and the Medical Corps arrive and whisk her away.

episodes_data.title: Yakumo Targeted: Sealed Abilities
episodes_data.description: Naruto has a dream about Yakumo wishing to become a ninja and Kurenai threatens to seal her power

episodes_data.title: Kurenai's Top-Secret Mission: A Promise with the Third
episodes_data.description: The assailants are members of the Kurama Clan of Hidden Leaf Village. Naruto and company rush to the villa to protect Yakumo.

episodes_data.title: Genjutsu or Reality? Those Who Control the Five Senses
episodes_data.description: Naruto goes to the hospital, when Unkai the ninja, who attacked them at the villa, appears. They search the village and come up with a theory based on the movement of Shino`s parasitic insects.

episodes_data.title: Power That Should Have Been Sealed
episodes_data.description: Naruto finds that Yakumo has put Kurenai in a desperate situation, and the terrible secret of the Kurama villa reveals itself.

episodes_data.title: Rare Artifact: The Importance of the Beauties of Nature
episodes_data.description: Naruto and Kiba`s mission is to guard a prized tea bowl and meet the client Shinemon.

episodes_data.title: The Enemy Is "Shinobazu"
episodes_data.description: Gantetsu, a member of the Ninja Dropouts requests a guarded escort out of Hidden Leaf Village.

episodes_data.title: Labyrinth Forest
episodes_data.description: After evading the ambush by the Ninja Dropouts, Naruto, Gantetsu, and Todoroki find themselves in a forest maze that confuses a human`s sense of direction.

episodes_data.title: Memories of Fire
episodes_data.description: The relationship between Gantetsu and Todoroki is revealed and tensions rise between the two.

episodes_data.title: The Respective Road
episodes_data.description: After a heated battle, Naruto has the enemy cornered, but a boy is taken. This boy turns out to be Akio, Todoroki`s younger brother, who Todoroki thought was dead.

episodes_data.title: Lost Memories
episodes_data.description: Naruto comes upon an injured youth who has lost his memory. Tsunade is cautious about the boy`s presence, but Naruto is impressed by the boys kindness and insists on allowing the boy to stay.

episodes_data.title: Recovered Reality
episodes_data.description: Tsunade believes that Menma has some connection to the Hidden Sound Village, and Naruto and the others head to the Land of Rice Paddies to check into Menma`s Memories.

episodes_data.title: A Past I Want to Erase
episodes_data.description: While in battle, Naruto finds out that Menma is a member of the gang of bandits that attacked their village. Being called a traitor by the leader of the gang, Menma reveals his greatest secret.

episodes_data.title: The Craftsman Goes Out: The Targeted Shukaku
episodes_data.description: Tsunade assigns Shikamaru a mission which is to solve the kidnapping case of the Sand Village ninja candidate Matsuri carried out by the Four Celestials. Leaf genin is called together once again.

episodes_data.title: The Sand's Allies: The Leaf's Shinobi
episodes_data.description: Shino, Hinata, and Neji search out the enemy while Shikamaru waits for the right moment to attack. The true intentions of the Four Celestials is to capture Gaara.

episodes_data.title: The Sealed Sand Water Tiger's Counterattack
episodes_data.description: Gaara`s opponents are setting up a trap and he is later caught in their secret jutsu, the Reverse Scale Position, and his sand is completely sealed.

episodes_data.title: The Revived Ultimate Weapon
episodes_data.description: Gaara and Naruto corner Hoko, the last of the Four Celestials, in a gully. They find out that their goal is to steal the Sand Spirit Shukaku`s chakra in order to gain the power to challenge the Five Great Nations.

episodes_data.title: Going on a Journey
episodes_data.description: Gaara transforms into Shukaku the Sand Spirit, and wins an impressive victory. After the battle, some discover new paths to follow, and Naruto decides to become even stronger by going on a training journey with Jiraiya.

Jump Festa 2004 - Mission: Protect the Waterfall Village!

background:
Naruto received numerous awards during its airing, including the Best Full-Length Animation Program Award in the third UStv Awards and the 38th Best Animated Show in IGN's Top 100 Animated Series.

The anime was released on DVD in 16 volumes by VIZ Media from July 4, 2006, to September 22, 2009. The company rereleased it in eight volumes from October 6, 2009, to December 14, 2010. VIZ Media also made available a Blu-ray version in eight volumes from November 3, 2020, to October 18, 2022.

The series adapts the first 27 volumes of the original manga.
